neither--adv.def: Used to say that a negative statement is also true of someone else.
neither--adv.ex: She does not smoke, and neither do I.
neither--adv.exTr: O sigara içmiyor, ben de içmiyorum.

upset--verb.def: To make someone unhappy, or to spoil a plan.
upset--verb.ex: The news upset the whole family.

evil--adj.def: Extremely bad and cruel on purpose.
evil--adj.ex: The story has an evil king.

evil--noun.def: Great wickedness, or something very harmful.
evil--noun.ex: The film explores the nature of evil.

store--verb.def: To keep something until it is needed.
store--verb.ex: Store the seeds in a dry place.

doubt--verb.def: To think that something is probably not true.
doubt--verb.ex: I doubt he will come tonight.

quit--adj.def: Free of something unwanted, used after the verb be.
quit--adj.ex: We are well quit of that trouble.

madam--noun.def: A polite way to address a woman you do not know.
madam--noun.ex: May I take your coat, madam?

wind--verb.def: To turn something around, or to twist a road.
wind--verb.ex: He wound the rope around the post.

jump--noun.def: An act of pushing yourself off the ground.
jump--noun.ex: Her jump broke the school record.

worst--adv.def: In the least good way of all.
worst--adv.exTr: En kötü etkilenen yer kıyı oldu.

fat--noun.def: The oily substance in food and under the skin.
fat--noun.ex: Cut the fat off the meat.

ow--noun.def: A sound you make when something hurts.
ow--noun.ex: He gave a sharp ow and pulled back.
ow--noun.exTr: Keskin bir "ay" sesi çıkarıp geri çekildi.

grand--adj.ex: They live in a grand old house.

mate--noun.def: A friend in British English, or an animal's partner.
mate--noun.ex: He went out with his mates.

risk--verb.def: To do something that could bring danger or loss.
risk--verb.ex: She risked her life to help them.
risk--verb.exTr: Onlara yardım için hayatını riske attı.

price--verb.def: To decide how much something costs.
price--verb.ex: The books are priced too high.

fit--noun.def: A sudden attack of illness or strong feeling.

guard--verb.def: To watch a place or a person to keep them safe.

spot--verb.def: To see or notice something suddenly.
spot--verb.ex: She spotted a mistake in the total.

narrator--noun.def: The person who tells a story in a book or a film.
narrator--noun.ex: The narrator speaks in the past tense.

witness--noun.def: A person who saw an event and can describe it.
witness--noun.ex: The witness gave a clear account.

energy--noun.def: The power to work, or the power that runs machines.

throat--noun.def: The passage at the back of your mouth.
throat--noun.ex: My throat hurts when I swallow.

track--verb.def: To follow the movements of a person or an animal.
track--verb.ex: Scientists track the birds by satellite.
track--verb.exTr: Bilim insanları kuşları uyduyla takip ediyor.

treat--verb.def: To behave towards someone, or to give medical care.
treat--verb.ex: Doctors treated her for a burn.
treat--verb.exTr: Doktorlar onu yanık için tedavi etti.

roll--verb.def: To turn over and over, or to wrap into a tube.
roll--verb.ex: The ball rolled under the car.

double--noun.def: Twice the amount, or a person who looks just like another.
double--noun.ex: He is the double of his father.

double--verb.def: To become twice as much, or to make it so.

level--verb.def: To make a surface flat, or to destroy a building completely.
level--verb.exTr: Deprem iki sokağı yerle bir etti.

pop--verb.def: To burst with a small sharp sound, or to go somewhere quickly.
pop--verb.ex: The cork popped out of the bottle.

client--noun.def: A person who pays for professional services.
client--noun.ex: The lawyer met his client at nine.

suspect--verb.def: To think that something is probably true or wrong.
suspect--verb.ex: Police suspect the fire was deliberate.

bottle--verb.def: To put a liquid into bottles.
bottle--verb.ex: They bottle the water at the spring.

shooting--noun.def: An event in which someone is shot with a gun.
shooting--noun.exTr: Silahlı saldırı gece yarısından sonra oldu.

willing--adj.def: Ready to do something without being forced.
willing--adj.ex: She is willing to work weekends.

faith--noun.def: Strong belief in a religion, or trust in someone.
faith--noun.ex: He kept his faith through hard years.

commander--noun.def: An officer in charge of a military group.

devil--noun.def: An evil spirit, or the chief evil being in religion.
devil--noun.ex: The painting shows a devil with wings.

correct--verb.def: To make something right, or to mark mistakes.

fellow--adj.def: Belonging to the same group or situation as you.

tight--adv.ex: Hold on tight to the rail.

rule--verb.def: To govern a country, or to make an official decision.
rule--verb.ex: The family ruled the island for centuries.

inspector--noun.def: An official who checks standards, or a police officer.

trial--noun.def: A legal process in court, or a test of something new.

file--verb.def: To store documents in order, or to make an official claim.
file--verb.ex: They filed a complaint against the firm.

minister--noun.def: A senior member of a government in charge of a department.
minister--noun.ex: The health minister visited the hospital.

plus--noun.def: An advantage, or the sign used for adding.
plus--noun.ex: Free parking is a real plus.

crew--noun.def: The people who work on a ship, a plane or a film.

challenge--verb.def: To question whether something is right, or to invite a contest.

coach--verb.def: To train a person or a team.

planning--noun.def: The work of deciding in advance what will be done.

project--noun.def: A piece of planned work with a clear aim.

project--verb.def: To estimate a future figure, or to throw an image onto a surface.
project--verb.ex: They project a rise in demand.

trick--verb.def: To deceive someone in order to get something.

united--adj.def: Joined together and acting as one.

criminal--adj.def: Relating to crime and the law that punishes it.

original--noun.def: The first version of something, not a copy.
original--noun.ex: Keep the original in a safe place.

research--verb.def: To study a subject carefully to discover facts.
research--verb.ex: She researched the topic for months.

pretend--adj.def: Not real, used in children's play.

female--noun.def: A woman, or an animal that can give birth.

dumb--adj.def: Stupid in informal speech, or unable to speak.
dumb--adj.ex: That was a dumb thing to say.

focus--noun.ex: Safety is the focus of this course.

issue--verb.def: To officially give out or publish something.

process--verb.def: To deal with documents or materials in an official way.

shower--verb.def: To wash under running water, or to give a lot of something.

gang--noun.def: An organized group of criminals or of young people.

fate--noun.def: The power believed to control events, or what happens to someone.

split--verb.def: To divide into parts, or to end a relationship.

expected--adj.def: Thought likely to happen or to arrive.

access--verb.def: To open or reach information or a place.
access--verb.ex: Students can access the archive online.

flat--adv.def: Completely, or in exactly that time.
flat--adv.ex: He ran it in two minutes flat.

screw--verb.def: To fasten something using a screw or a twisting motion.

harm--noun.def: Damage or injury caused to someone.

community--noun.def: The people living in one area, or a group sharing interests.
community--noun.exTr: Bütün topluluk yeniden inşaya yardım etti.

spare--adj.def: Kept in case it is needed, or not being used.

spare--verb.def: To give time or money, or to save someone from harm.

contract--noun.def: A legal agreement between two sides.

trade--verb.def: To buy and sell goods, or to exchange things.
trade--verb.ex: The city traded in silk and spices.
trade--verb.exTr: Şehir ipek ve baharat ticareti yapardı.

divorce--noun.def: The legal ending of a marriage.
